hints.title: Attendance Disqualification Conditions
hints.text: The student remains eligible for an award if absent fewer than two days in total and never late for three or more consecutive days.

hints.title: Absence Count And Consecutive Lateness Invariant
hints.text: Counting total occurrences of absent days and checking for a three consecutive late character sequence determines award eligibility in one inspection.

hints.title: Dual Condition String Scan Procedure
hints.text: Traverse the string to count occurrences of character A and check for three consecutive L characters. If total absences are strictly less than two and no three consecutive late characters appear, return true. Otherwise return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Complex state machines or regular expressions introduce unnecessary code overhead for two simple condition checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan verifies both conditions in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the two criteria clearly: absent count < 2 and no three consecutive late marks.
